text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Friday.
- The government extends the deadline for handing over weapons for another six months.
- The Croatian cellular phones grid suffers a collapse due to overload. German and Austrian experts called in to fix the problem.
- European Union to decide on cooperation with Croatia by February or March.
- Croatian government announces an agreed $100 million World Bank loan for bank rehabilitation.
- The highest salary in November was 50,000 kuna paid to a banker, according to the central payments bureau.
- Interview with the rightist HDZ official and MP, Vice Vukojevic: Some provisions of recent agreements with the Vatican constitute an infringement of the Croatian sovreignty.
- First Croatian edition of the Playboy presented ahead of the February 3 publishing. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
